articles.title: A memecoin making app becomes crypto’s top fee generators as Robinhood Chain activity explodes
articles.snippet: Users paid nearly $6 million in a day to create and trade tokens through Pons, more than they paid to use Pump or Hyperliquid, and even more than they paid to use Robinhood Chain itself.

articles.title: FX has stopped reading bond yields the old way. Bitcoin should too.
Catastrophe bonds may join tokenization rush, with plans for test issuance in 2027
articles.snippet: A law firm and a tokenization platform say their proposed structure would give investors legal ownership of cat bonds onchain and could lower the minimum investment.

articles.title: Dogecoin becomes only losing bet for Japan-listed firm as it sells altcoins for bitcoin
articles.snippet: Remixpoint booked gains on ether, solana and XRP, but sold DOGE below its fiscal-year opening value as it concentrated its crypto holdings in bitcoin.

articles.title: Kraken parent Payward delays IPO to second quarter of 2027 at earliest
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange operator, which confidentially filed for a U.S. listing last November, had already put its IPO plans on hold amid difficult market conditions.
